primary_rule: Civilians may not be made the object of attack.
required_analysis: Assess status, direct participation, doubt rules, and available intelligence.
risk_flags: Labeling all military-age males as combatants; weak intelligence; retrospective justification.

primary_rule: Civilian objects may not be attacked unless they become military objectives.
required_analysis: Determine nature, location, purpose, or use and contribution to military action.
risk_flags: Dual-use infrastructure; hospitals; schools; power grids; communications systems.

primary_rule: Incidental harm must not be excessive relative to concrete and direct military advantage.
required_analysis: Compare expected civilian casualties and damage with anticipated military advantage.
risk_flags: Speculative military advantage; aggregated campaign benefits; undercounted civilian presence.

primary_rule: Effective advance warning must be given where circumstances permit.
required_analysis: Evaluate feasibility, specificity, timing, safe routes, and actual civilian capacity to comply.
risk_flags: Evacuation orders without safe destination; siege conditions; disabled or detained populations.

primary_rule: Weapons and tactics must comply with IHL limits.
required_analysis: Assess weapon effects, area impact, indiscriminate risks, and special protections.
risk_flags: Explosive weapons in dense urban areas; autonomous systems; cyber cascading effects.
